title: Daybreak handover: action track and escalation summary
content:
SUMMARY:

This handover covers the 08:00–20:00 PT watch (2028-11-17). Primary focus: two escalations (embed pipeline latency spike and a misrouted Canary that caused region fallthrough). Both were contained with degraded-mode mitigation; no customer SLA breaches recorded but some increased 95th/99th latency for embeddings.

CURRENT CLUSTER HEALTH (2028-11-18 06:45 PT):
- Overall API: green (2xx rate 99.95%).
- Hosted embeddings: service-level P99 elevated to 1.6s (baseline 0.9s).
- Serving runtime GPU pools: healthy; low GPU memory pressure except on dedicated-pool-3 where kvcache fragmentation observed.
- Queues: backpressure spikes noted for short interval 09:12–09:27 PT; now normalized.

INCIDENTS DURING SHIFT (short recaps):
1) INC-4821: Embedding pipeline latency spike (09:05–10:02 PT)
   - Trigger: sudden increase in long-tail sequences for batcher resulting in batch formation delays; continuous-batching policy allowed larger batch timeouts to form which increased tail latency.
   - Detection: automatic alert from latency-regression job + customer report via support channel.
   - Triage steps taken:
     * 09:08: Scoped to embeddings route /v1/embeddings; rerouted lower-tier traffic to eu-fallback cluster using routing policy 'latency-degrade' while investigation continued.
     * 09:15: Identified that quantization fallback path on dedicated-pool-3 caused additional KV cache CPU overhead.
     * 09:35: Applied temporary batcher override (max_delay_ms reduced from 50 -> 20) in the runtime config for embeddings-serve group.
   - Mitigation: batcher override + targeted reroute. P99 started improving at 09:42 and normalized by 10:05.
   - Post-action: Created follow-up to adjust automatic batcher heuristics for sequences >1024 tokens.
   - Severity: Sev-2; postmortem scheduled.

2) INC-4826: Canary routing misconfiguration (15:10–15:40 PT)
   - Trigger: release engineer rolled out canary with legacy model alias; smart-routing policy considered legacy-compatible and fallback caused region fallthrough to SFO from ORD for certain customer TAGs.
   - Detection: Observability spike on cross-region egress and small increase in error budget alerts.
   - Triage steps:
     * 15:12: Scoped and pinned the canary traffic to the release lane; disabled smart-routing for that lane.
     * 15:20: Rolled back the canary deployment and forced route to primary region.
   - Mitigation: rollback and lock to region.
   - Notes: Need an automated guard to prevent smart-routing evaluation for model aliases marked 'compat:legacy'.

RUNBOOK & PLAYBOOK NOTES (draft diffs to apply):
- Batcher heuristics: add a guard that short-circuits continuous-batching when 95th percentile sequence length > 512 OR when KV cache pressure on GPU node > 75%. See candidate rule in PR 312.
- Canary routing: add a 'compatibility' flag on model aliases that excludes them from smart-routing buckets. Add pre-deploy check in release pipeline that validates alias flags.
- Embeddings route: temporary config used (max_delay_ms=20) — revert in runtime after PR is merged to update adaptive batcher. Add a one-line toc in runbook: how to change max_delay_ms and safe rollbacks.

OPEN ACTIONS (owner | due):
- Aisha: Draft postmortem for INC-4821 including query sample and batcher timeline (due 2028-11-20).
- Marco: Implement batcher guard prototype and open RFC describing tradeoffs (due 2028-11-24).
- Evan: Add CI pre-check to release pipeline to validate model-alias compatibility flags (PR opened; due 2028-11-22).
- Sofia: Audit dedicated-pool-3 kvcache fragmentation; propose remediation (GC/eviction adjustments) (due 2028-11-21).

FOLLOWUPS & NOTES TO NEXT SHIFT:
- Watch embedding p99 for next 24h; PagerDuty escalation threshold temporarily reduced to 1.3s for embeddings route.
- If P99 crosses 2.0s again, execute emergency-degrade plan: switch embeddings traffic to smaller-quantized variants and increase autoscaler min nodes by +2 in eu cluster. Runbook section: "Emergency degrade for embeddings" updated at 09:50 PT — see linked PR.
- Keep an eye on cross-region egress billing for canary fallthrough; finance notified for a potential small credit if costs exceed threshold.

DETAILED TIMELINE (high level):
- 09:05: Alert triggered from latency-regression job (inc 4821).
- 09:08: Initial triage; identified route.
- 09:15: Identified kvcache CPU overhead on dedicated-pool-3.
- 09:35: Applied batcher override.
- 09:42: Metrics trending down.
- 10:05: P99 normalized.
- 15:10: Canary flagged by routing-monitor (inc 4826).
- 15:12: Scoped and disabled smart-routing for canary lane.
- 15:20: Canary rolled back.
- 15:40: Metrics stabilized.

COMMUNICATIONS:
- Support thread: #support-embeddings (linked to INC-4821).
- Release thread: #releases (canary discussion).
- Customers notified: Two customers on heartbeat plan got proactive messages from CS at 10:25 PT.

LEARNINGS & SUGGESTIONS:
- Continuous-batching heuristics are vulnerable to sudden shifts in sequence-length distribution; we need an adaptive knob that reduces batching windows when long-tail sequences increase.
- Model alias metadata needs to be richer (compatibility, fallback-policy, region-strict) and enforced in releases.
- Observability: add a metric for kvcache fragmentation and expose it in per-pool dashboard.

QUICK COMMANDS & REMEDIATION CHECKLISTS (for the oncoming watch):
- To reduce embedding batch delay quickly: edit runtime config embeddings-serve -> max_delay_ms to 20 and reload config (runtime-reload agent).
- To force route away from a GPU pool: update routing policy from console -> select route -> set preferred_pools.
- To rollback canary immediately: release pipeline -> revert canary commit -> promote previous deploy.

CONTACTS (on-call escalation ladder):
- Primary SRE: Aisha Patel (pager: +1-555-0198)
- Secondary: Marco Li (pager: +1-555-0203)
- Release engineer: Evan Brooks (slack: @evanb)

ATTACHMENTS & REFERENCES:
- Candidate PR for batcher guard: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-playbooks/pull/312
- Observability dashboard: confluence link in linked_artifacts above

Notes to next shift: please validate that PD thresholds reverted to default after 24 hours if no regressions. If any automatic mitigations are still active, annotate why they remain.

-- End of handover --
